Example Sentence: 시험 기간인데 게으름을 피우면 안 돼.
English: to slack off / to act lazy
Sentence Translation: You shouldn't slack off during the exam period.

Example Sentence: 처음 보는 사람이 나에게 말을 걸었다.
English: to initiate a conversation / to speak to
Sentence Translation: A stranger initiated a conversation with me.

Example Sentence: 알고 보니 우리는 같은 고향 출신이었다.
English: as it turns out / come to find out
Sentence Translation: As it turned out, we were from the same hometown.
Etymology: 알다 (to know) + -고 보니 (grammar pattern: realizing after experiencing)

Example Sentence: 이 맛있는 케이크를 한 번 먹어 보세요.
English: to try doing [verb] / to do [verb] and see
Sentence Translation: Please try eating this delicious cake.

Example Sentence: 다음 달에 한국으로 출장을 가게 되었어요.
English: to end up doing / to get to do
Sentence Translation: I ended up going on a business trip to Korea next month.

Example Sentence: 비가 오는데 차라리 집에 있는 게 낫겠어.
English: would rather [do something] / it is better to
Sentence Translation: It's raining, so I would rather stay at home.
Etymology: 차라리 (rather) + -는 게 (the act of) + 낫다 (to be better)

Sentence Translation: Won't you wake up and work right now?
